baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future passive verb at word 1 places a subject aside, while the superlative at word 2 names maximal self-protective caution.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inwardly acquired habit of guarding is paired with an outward causative relocation. The subject does not merely avoid danger by personal effort; another agency completes that effort by putting the subject in a removed position.

activation_trace.role: Removal to a side supplies the passive spatial operation performed on the subject.
Placing oneself under protective caution supplies the subject's prior disposition.

changed_reading.before: A pious person will simply be spared.
changed_reading.after: The most self-guarding person is made to occupy a removed position; granted deliverance completes a practiced placing of the self under protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The side-root at word 1 can organize a flank, edge, or precinct and can also image a shield held at the side; word 2 supplies the protective-barrier logic.
baseline_models.mechanism: Side, shield, and barrier branches create layered geometry. Safety is not only more distance from an unnamed object but assignment to a screened flank where the boundary itself bears the exposure.

activation_trace.role: The bodily flank and spatial edge supply a lateral safe-side geometry.
A cover or shield stationed at the side turns that geometry into active screening.
A guard interposed against harm supplies the barrier function of the screened flank.

changed_reading.before: Being kept away means only increasing the distance from danger.
changed_reading.after: The protected subject is assigned to a safe flank and screened at the boundary, so lateral placement and interposition coexist with distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive verb at word 1 also touches a branch of leading something alongside, while word 2 has a branch of wary, pain-avoiding movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two branches permit controlled proximity: a guarded subject can be conducted along the edge of danger rather than abandoned or exposed to it. Safety then lies in guided adjacency and calibrated movement.

activation_trace.role: Leading or keeping a being alongside supplies an escort rather than a bare expulsion.
A guarded gait around painful ground supplies cautious movement within that escort.

changed_reading.before: Safety requires complete absence from the threatening field.
changed_reading.after: Safety may be a conducted passage along the field's edge, with proximity controlled by an escort and a guarded gait.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening cover-and-disclosure cycle turns the baseline safe flank into a moving exposure boundary. As a surface is successively covered, opened, and disclosed, the protected subject is held on the side that does not become exposed to the threatening field.

activation_trace.role: A spatial side supplies the flank on which exposure can be controlled.
An interposed guard supplies continuity of protection while visibility changes.
A cover laid over a thing supplies the obscured phase of the boundary.
Opening and widening until passage or flow supplies expansion of the exposed field.
Disclosure supplies the visible phase against which protected placement becomes legible.

structural_cues: The opening oath alternates a covering event with a disclosure event.
The repeated conditional construction makes exposure cyclical rather than a single static backdrop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, opening, and disclosure; I infer that their alternation changes which side is exposed and that the passive focus placement tracks that boundary. A live alternative is that the opening pair supplies only cosmic contrast without a protective mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The subject is placed once on a permanently safe side.
changed_reading.after: The subject is kept on the unexposed side of an alternating cover-and-disclosure boundary, making protection dynamic rather than static.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful movement is declared dispersed and far apart. The focus-side operation therefore reads as the terminal sorting of trajectories: one course is made to run on a protected flank rather than merely receiving an isolated exemption.

activation_trace.role: Removal and separation supply the operation that sorts one trajectory away from another.
Self-protective caution identifies the disposition carried by the protected trajectory.
Purposeful movement toward an objective supplies trajectories rather than static moral labels.
Dispersion supplies the branching of the trajectories.
Distance between two things supplies the widening separation between their endpoints.

structural_cues: The plural possessive on striving is followed by a predicate of divergence.
The focus clause remains future passive, so final sorting is done to the protected subject rather than narrated as self-exile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies goal-directed motion and dispersion; I infer divergent routes whose endpoints are enacted by later facilitation and side-setting. A live alternative is that the context states only diversity of deeds, with no spatial route model.

changed_reading.before: One individual receives a private rescue unrelated to the movement of others.
changed_reading.after: The focus is one endpoint of a route-sorting system: divergent strivings become divergent courses, and the self-guarding course is laterally separated from the destructive one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving opens the hand, active self-guarding places the actor behind protection, fulfilled action makes the affirmed good operative, and facilitation opens a traversable course. The focus passive then completes this active sequence by relocating the same kind of subject beyond the hazard.

activation_trace.role: Being removed to the side supplies the externally completed outcome of the earlier actions.
Self-placement under protection supplies the disposition named in superlative form at the focus.
Handing something over supplies the release of possession that begins the active sequence.
Active self-guarding supplies the earlier practice later condensed into the focus superlative.
Making a promise or action true supplies enacted verification rather than assent alone.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the traversable course that precedes final removal.

structural_cues: A sequence of active perfect verbs is followed by a future causative of facilitation.
The focus repeats future causative force but changes to passive voice, shifting completion away from the human actor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered actions and later facilitation; I infer a causal process in which practiced guarding becomes a disposition and granted side-setting completes it. A live alternative is a looser reward sequence in which the earlier deeds do not generate the later route.

changed_reading.before: The superlative is a static rank that qualifies an otherwise unexplained beneficiary.
changed_reading.after: The superlative compresses a history of giving, guarding, and verified action, while the passive future marks a completion that the actor cannot perform alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventory places gentle path-direction beside a form-distant image of a difficult descent. Together with the focus branches of removal and guarded footing, they activate a topographic reading in which one subject is conducted onto a safe contour while a counterroute drops away.

activation_trace.role: Lateral removal supplies the transfer from one contour or route to another.
Guarded footing supplies careful passage over injurious terrain.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies the positive steering force.
The non-dominant split image of a difficult descent supplies a deliberately form-distant counterroute.

structural_cues: A fall toward destruction appears immediately before the assertion of guidance.
Earlier paired facilitation clauses already establish easier and harder courses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordinary gentle guidance and, under the split mapping, a steep descent; I use them as contrasting topographic activators and do not claim that guidance lexically means descent. A live alternative keeps only the dominant guidance branch and loses the counterroute.

changed_reading.before: The protected subject is displaced without any account of how the safe side is found.
changed_reading.after: Protection becomes guided topography: careful footing follows a gently indicated contour while the unprotected counterroute steepens into descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning, eventual outcome, and delay make the focus future legible as the later phase of a process whose first phase is self-guarding. Protection can begin as present orientation and reach its outcome as externally effected removal.

activation_trace.role: Future removal supplies the process's later completed phase.
Self-guarding supplies a first phase already active in the subject.
Deferral to a later time supplies temporal distance before completion.
The beginning of a thing supplies the process's first phase.
Return to an eventual outcome supplies continuity between the first phase and its consummation.

structural_cues: The first and the later are paired under a single possession claim.
The focus verb is explicitly future while its subject is already described by an established disposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firstness, laterness, delay, and outcome; I infer that they distribute protection across a first phase of practiced caution and a later phase of removal. A live alternative treats the temporal pair as domains of sovereignty without assigning stages to the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Protection is a single deferred event with no present phase.
changed_reading.after: Protection spans two times: self-guarding begins the trajectory in the first domain, and passive removal consummates it in the later domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning awakens caution, the formerly unspecified feminine object becomes a blazing fire, and the preceding subject is defined by contact with its heat. The decisive reversal is agential: the denier voluntarily turns away yet reaches the fire, whereas the self-guarding subject is passively turned aside from it.

activation_trace.role: Effective removal from a harmful object supplies the successful directional reversal.
Protective caution supplies the disposition capable of receiving and acting on warning.
A warning that frightens and wakes caution supplies the signal preceding protection.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete hazardous object later resumed by the feminine pronoun.
Pure, intensely kindled flame supplies the hazard's active reach.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the contact state opposed to focus removal.
The non-dominant mapped image of wretchedness supplies the contrasting superlative subject.
Voluntary turning away supplies the failed self-directed motion reversed by passive protective motion.

structural_cues: The same feminine object pronoun links fire-contact in 92:15 with side-setting in 92:17.
The two clauses oppose exception-marked superlative subjects.
The focus future passive immediately follows a relative clause of denial and voluntary turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, flame, heat-contact, wretchedness, and turning away; I infer an irony in which voluntary moral aversion fails while receptive caution is completed by an effective external redirection. A live alternative reads the sequence as a straightforward contrast without emphasizing reversed agency.

changed_reading.before: An abstractly pious person is spared from an unspecified threat.
changed_reading.after: The warned and self-guarding subject is effectively turned aside from the blazing fire, while the subject who turns himself away from warning paradoxically makes contact with it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth moves outward while the giver undergoes inward growth and purification. The focus superlative is therefore not only an antecedent rank; it is formed and renewed through a transfer that appears as loss at the boundary but growth in the subject.

activation_trace.role: Removal supplies the outward separation that is paired with inward transformation.
Self-protective formation supplies the subject changed by the transfer.
Giving supplies the outward transfer rather than mere arrival.
Possessed wealth supplies the material that crosses the subject's boundary.
Increase and growth supply the non-depleting result of the outward transfer.
Purification supplies the qualitative remaking of the giver.

structural_cues: The post-focus relative clause identifies the protected subject through an ongoing act of giving.
The reflexive purification verb makes the outward transfer and inward change simultaneous.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, wealth, growth, and purification; I infer a feedback mechanism in which release of possession forms the guarding disposition that precedes protection. A live alternative makes giving only evidence of an already complete type rather than a formative act.

changed_reading.before: The protected subject first possesses maximal caution and only afterward happens to give.
changed_reading.after: The subject becomes and remains maximally self-guarding through regenerative transfer: wealth exits, while the giver grows and is purified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of any benefactor present with the giver and awaiting repayment removes the ordinary social shield of patronage. Side-nearness in the focus is reconfigured: the subject is not protected by a creditor or patron at his side but is freed from the reciprocal claim itself.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and companionship at one's side supply the social adjacency being reconfigured.
A protective barrier poses the question of what, or who, actually shields the subject.
Exhaustive negation removes every candidate human patron or creditor.
Presence and nearness supply the image of a claim held with the giver.
Benefit and good condition supply the favor that could create reciprocal obligation.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocity explicitly denied.
Collecting and satisfying a debt sharpens the denied relation into a creditor-debtor mechanism.

structural_cues: A universal negative construction excludes every human source of a repayable favor.
The locative expression places the hypothetical favor in the giver's immediate social vicinity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal negation, nearness, favor, recompense, and debt collection; I infer a social topology in which freedom from horizontal claims is itself protective. A live alternative takes the clause only as a statement of pure motive, without making release from reciprocity part of the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The subject may be safe because a patron, benefactor, or reciprocal exchange stands behind him.
changed_reading.after: The subject is side-set without a human patron at his side: protection coincides with release from the creditor-debtor network rather than dependence on it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeking, direction, nurturing sovereignty, and elevation give the focus removal a positive vector. The subject is not merely pushed into marginal space away from fire; the safe side is selected by orientation toward a higher face and an completing, nurturing lordship.

activation_trace.role: A side or direction supplies the lateral component of the new vector.
Protective self-orientation supplies the subject's readiness to follow that vector.
Active seeking supplies directed desire rather than aimless flight.
A direction or orientation supplies the vector's positive endpoint.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply the agency that can finish the protective movement.
Elevation supplies a vertical component to the otherwise lateral movement.

structural_cues: An exception phrase replaces every repayable human motive with one stated object of seeking.
The compact genitive chain binds face, lordship, and elevation into a single orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, direction, nurturing completion, and elevation; I infer a vector in which movement away from fire is simultaneously movement toward a selected orientation. A live alternative treats the later phrase only as motive and leaves the focus movement purely negative.

changed_reading.before: Being put aside is negative motion whose only content is distance from fire.
changed_reading.after: The displacement is a reorientation: lateral escape from fire is governed by a sought, elevated direction and completed by nurturing sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two future clauses form a sequence from defensive relocation to positive contentment. Maximal caution is not an endless anxious condition; once the threatening relation is broken, guarding can yield to acceptance and settled satisfaction.

activation_trace.role: Removal from the harmful relation supplies the necessary negative phase.
Protective caution supplies the provisional defensive posture.
Acceptance in place of displeasure supplies the positive state that follows defense.

structural_cues: The focus and closing clauses both carry explicit future marking.
The post-focus relative clauses maintain the same subject through to the closing satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two future promises and a final state of acceptance; I infer a sequence in which protection makes contentment possible and ends perpetual vigilance. A live alternative keeps the promises parallel but causally independent.

changed_reading.before: The most cautious subject remains defined forever by fear and avoidance.
changed_reading.after: Caution is transitional: passive removal breaks the danger relation so that the protected subject can pass from vigilance into settled contentment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the wind branch is noun-like and form-distant from the focus verb. It remains anchored in the focus side-root, its barrier companion, and the context's engulfing kindled flame. Downstream prose should present it only as a material hazard analogy, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus side-root contains a south-wind image, while the focus protection-root can interpose a barrier.

activation_trace.role: A directional wind and what it drives supply plume movement across a field.
An interposed barrier supplies protection from the moving hazard.
An engulfing cover supplies the spatial spread of the hazard.
Kindled fire supplies the material source carried through the field.
Intensely kindled flame supplies the dangerous plume front.

changed_reading.before: The verse names only a moral exemption from fire.
changed_reading.after: A material hazard map flickers into view: the protected subject is shifted to a windward flank outside an engulfing flame front.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because herd milk scarcity and perennial forage are not ordinary senses of the focus verb. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because both images belong to the focus root and are joined by context branches of milk-yield, wealth, and growth. Downstream prose should call it an ecological-economic analogy and preserve the uncertainty.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus side-root contains both a dry-herd condition and a rooted perennial growth that protects livestock, while the focus protection-root supplies preservation from harm.

activation_trace.role: Loss of herd milk supplies the scarcity regime from which protection is imagined.
Rooted perennial forage that remains through scarcity supplies a regenerative reserve.
Preservation behind a guard supplies the reserve's protective function.
Milk-yield and flock growth supply the productive regime opposed to dryness.
Accumulated wealth supplies the stock that can be hoarded or released.
Growth and increase supply regeneration after wealth leaves the giver.

changed_reading.before: Giving wealth appears to reduce the giver's protective reserve.
changed_reading.after: Generosity behaves like perennial forage rather than depletion: released stock enters a growth cycle that side-sets the giver from a sterile scarcity regime.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it combines distant racing, guarded-gait, gaming-lot, and follower branches. It remains anchored in the focus image of a led or spare animal kept alongside and in the surah's explicit striving and route contrast. Downstream prose should retain it as a competitive-topology analogy, never as the syntax's direct sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus side-root contains the image of a led animal or spare horse kept alongside, and the focus protection-root contains a pain-avoiding guarded gait.

activation_trace.role: A led animal or spare horse kept alongside supplies the reserve-runner position.
Guarded movement that avoids injuring the hoof supplies controlled expenditure in the course.
Contending in purposeful motion supplies the competitive field.
Lots, gaming, and division of a slaughtered animal supply a consuming contest with assigned shares.
A runner following the leader supplies a race-order image at the point of fire-contact.

changed_reading.before: The protected figure simply wins the same contest as everyone else.
changed_reading.after: The protected figure is withheld as a guarded reserve runner on the side, escaping a contest whose track consumes those committed to it.

strongest_changes: The focus passive became the external completion of an active history of self-guarding rather than a bare reward for a static label.
Divergent striving, facilitation, and guidance turned simple distance into a route-sorting and safe-flank mechanism.
The fire sequence resolved the object and exposed an agency reversal: voluntary turning away reaches the fire, while receptive caution is effectively turned aside from it.
Post-focus giving and purification made protection regenerative, while the denial of repayment recast it as release from a human debt-and-patronage network.
Seeking a higher face gave the away-motion a positive vector, and final satisfaction allowed vigilance to terminate rather than define the subject forever.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots formed a double mechanism of side-setting and self-shielding. Context repeatedly changed its domain without dissolving that anchor: visibility boundary, branching route, fire-contact reversal, economic release, directed orientation, and finally contentment. The strangest live activations arose where wind, forage, milk-yield, and race branches turned the same mechanism into material analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The safe-flank and side-shield readings are branch-supported but remain less morphologically direct than ordinary avoidance.
The first-and-later model depends on a reader-supplied staging of one process across the temporal pair.
The non-dominant steep-descent branch under the guidance cue is deliberately form-distant and should not displace the dominant path-direction branch.
The causal arrows from giving to formation of the protected self, and from protection to contentment, are abductive rather than explicitly stated.
The wind, ecological, and race outliers are mechanisms for exploratory prose, not candidate lexical translations.
